{{Top|leg}}
'''Effectiveness of Standard Escort and Patrol Tactics Against Enemy Interdiction''' was the title of a report authored by the [[Imperial Commission on the Conduct of the War]]. It detailed the events surrounding the destruction of the [[fuel container]] ''[[Transtom]]'', the [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[Walker (treasury ship)|''Walker'']], and the loss of a convoy near [[Engira]].
